entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A Sunstar squire adrift on the Seriema who questions the Sum after Taro-duend, is overpowered by Tezzeret, and agrees to send a message to the Free Company as part of Sami's plan.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist apostate with a hole in his hand who wants to live, bonds uneasily with Haliya, and joins Sami's plan to escape Sothera.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Captain of the Seriema who devises a plan to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline and wants to keep searching for their cat Mirri.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Sami's Kav first mate who admits he is hiding something about the Endstone and insists on going along.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A metal-bodied wizard with a human head who says he can walk between realities and sells the Endstone, intending to follow it to its maker; he paralyzes Haliya's armor with a gesture.

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: An Illvoi cloudsculptor expelled from the Uthros Combine who advises Tezzeret and deduced the existence of a causality manipulator in Sothera.

entities.name: Mantis
entities.description: A Eumidian director of Pinnacle's Infinite Guideline station and secret Summist who learns of the Kavaron atrocity and resigns as director to become Checkmate.

entities.name: Checkmate
entities.description: Mantis's mechan Checkmate, an adversarial counselor who inherits the post of director of Infinite Guideline by emergency protocol.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A Solar Knight now held in Pinnacle custody at Infinite Guideline, who warns Mantis that both sides will blockade the station to stop the artifact.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Sami's lost cat, who weftwalked several years ago.

entities.name: Raphaella
entities.description: Alpharael's sister, whom the Monoists sent into Sothera and whom he dreamed burning.

entities.name: Slats
entities.description: The Dawnsire's Astelli captain who granted Alpharael mercy.

entities.name: The Endstone
entities.description: A causality-bending stone that was made and then buried at Sigma and wants to return to its maker; it chose or marked Alpharael and is now in a stasis cask.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's disabled ship, drifting near Kavaron and repaired by the Illvoi.

entities.name: Sundog
entities.description: The Sunstar palestar that failed to catch the Seriema.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: The Pinnacle station and eternity-column gateway where the Free Company and Monoists are massing fleets.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The system with a supervoid at its center where the Free Company and Monoists contend.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A storm giant near whose libratory point lies something the crystal points to.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The Monoist center of strategic gravity.

entities.name: Adagia
entities.description: A Summist colony under mirrorscapes.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The ruined Kav world where six thousand died in the atrocity.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: The Kav town destroyed by the Sundog.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: A jungle world emerging from an ice age with a Eumidian colony.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: A debris cloud the narrator says they will go to.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A distant world Tezzeret says Tannuk is far from.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The neutral administrators of Pinnacle space that cannot stop the Free Company or Monasteriat but can deny passage through the eternity column.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Palatinate's fighting order that violated its agreement with Pinnacle by killing six thousand Kav and is massing fleets at Infinite Guideline.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: The titanic power behind the Free Company, rival to the Monasteriat.

entities.name: Monasteriat
entities.description: The Monoist power at Point Prime, rival to the Palatinate and building a temple at Susur Secundi.

entities.name: Illvoi
entities.description: Jellyfish-like cloudsculptors who live in gas giants and repair the Seriema.

entities.name: Uthros Combine
entities.description: The Illvoi research outfit that expelled Mm'menon.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: Insectoid terraformers, one of whom is Mantis.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: The Sunstar ship with a weapon that can reignite supervoids as stars; both sides hold weapons in reserve for a confrontation over it.

entities.name: Sum
entities.description: The Sunstar faith's principle of maximizing life, which Haliya doubts and Mantis privately worships.

entities.name: Mallowmass
entities.description: A custom obliging a host to shelter and defend a guest, which Sami says is sacred.

entities.name: Anstruth
entities.description: A being or outcome altered by the object, which Haliya fears applies to her.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The Monoist deity of the end of time, thought by some to have made the Endstone.

events.summary: Haliya takes a defensive position and resolves to stop Alpharael from taking the ship or using the Endstone.
events.quote: Her goal is to prevent Alpharael from taking the ship or using the object.

events.summary: Haliya rejects destroying the rock because it would violate mallowmass.
events.quote: But that would violate mallowmass.

events.summary: Haliya summons Alpharael to meet with her.
events.quote: Eventually, the Summist calls Alpharael to meet with her.

events.summary: Haliya proposes a détente with Alpharael.
events.quote: "We must reach an accord," she says.

events.summary: Haliya says the Sum told her to kill everyone aboard and herself, but she did not.
events.quote: Only the Sum says that I was supposed to kill everyone on this ship, including myself.

events.summary: Haliya calls Alpharael an apostate and offers to take up his case.
events.quote: "So, you're an apostate," she says happily.

events.summary: Haliya says she will argue that Slats rightly granted Alpharael mercy.
events.quote: I'll beg your pardon, and that means I have no duty to kill you.

events.summary: Haliya takes off her helmet and says the Free Company's armor is no longer hers.
events.quote: Haliya takes her helmet off, moving so sharply that Alpharael flinches away.

events.summary: Alpharael gives Haliya a bottle of cleaning solute.
events.quote: I got you a present, by the way.

events.summary: Sami announces over the intercom that the Metalman has arrived and prefers the name Tezzeret.
events.quote: The Metalman's here. Come out and present yourselves, or he'll present you.

events.summary: Tezzeret enters the Seriema from his black engineless ship.
events.quote: He pushes into the Seriema with the calm of a prybar.

events.summary: Tezzeret questions Haliya about her armor.
events.quote: "You wear a wealth of metal," he says.

events.summary: Tezzeret is delighted that Alpharael fled his creed to live.
events.quote: I wanted to live a little longer.

events.summary: Tezzeret studies Tannuk, remarking on Llanowar and the power he is afraid of.
events.quote: So far from Llanowar … such power in the form.

events.summary: Tezzeret greets Sami as the protector of strays and asks for his prize.
events.quote: Sami, the generous. Sami, the charitable. Sami, the protector of strays.

events.summary: Sami tells Tezzeret the stone changes the past, as with the vanished miners of Sigma.
events.quote: Change the past to suit its purposes.

events.summary: Tezzeret laughs at Haliya's objection to counterfeit memories.
events.quote: Listen to her! Counterfeit memories, an atrocity.

events.summary: Tezzeret says he will see the stone now.
events.quote: You're keeping it in your hold. I'll see it now.

events.summary: Haliya says she cannot let Tezzeret take the object.
events.quote: "I can't let you take the object," Haliya says.

events.summary: Tezzeret says he arranged events so the stone would choose him as its conduit.
events.quote: I have arranged all this so it will choose me as its conduit.

events.summary: Tezzeret calls the stone the Endstone, as Alpharael's people name it.
events.quote: It's what your people call it. Isn't it, boy? The stone from the end.

events.summary: Tezzeret declares he will never serve again and wants nothing from the Endstone.
events.quote: I won't flee to a better world. I'll stand and face whoever would rule me.

events.summary: Tezzeret says the Endstone was made and buried and he will follow it to its maker.
events.quote: I must know who made it.

events.summary: Tezzeret explains he has made himself the shortest path to ground for the Endstone, like lightning.
events.quote: I have made myself the shortest path for the Endstone to reach its maker.

events.summary: Tezzeret silently forces Haliya's armor to close on her.
events.quote: her armor ripples like porridge and closes on her.

events.summary: Tezzeret releases Haliya, who drifts limp, and moves to consult the Endstone.
events.quote: Haliya drifts away spinning, limbs limp.

events.summary: Tezzeret drops a crystal over a map of Sothera and it rolls to a libratory point near Uthros.
events.quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

events.summary: Tezzeret reads the crystal's result as Uthros and says he will alert Mm'menon.
events.quote: Uthros. The stone wants to go to Uthros.

events.summary: Mantis learns that six thousand died on Kavaron.
events.quote: Six thousand dead on Kavaron.

events.summary: Mantis reflects that the Free Company violated its agreement with Pinnacle and that Pinnacle stays neutral.
events.quote: The Free Company has violated the terms of its agreement with Pinnacle.

events.summary: Mantis tells Checkmate that Pinnacle can only deny passage through the eternity column.
events.quote: We have no power to arrest or pursue the guilty.

events.summary: Mantis deduces that a Monoist warship is within Pinnacle's controlled space.
events.quote: There is a Monoist warship inside our controlled space,

events.summary: Vondam, in Pinnacle custody, is questioned by Mantis.
events.quote: He surrendered his ship to the Kav, without contest, on the condition that he be delivered directly to Infinite Guideline and Pinnacle custody.

events.summary: Vondam warns that both sides will blockade the eternity column.
events.quote: That they must blockade the eternity column and prevent any ship from escaping Sothera.

events.summary: Vondam tells Mantis an artifact is present in Sothera that the enemy cannot obtain.
events.quote: We have discovered that there is an artifact present in Sothera which we cannot permit the enemy to obtain.

events.summary: Mantis resigns as director of Infinite Guideline and Checkmate inherits the post.
events.quote: I resign my post as director of the Infinite Guideline effective immediately.

events.summary: Vondam describes an unstable double stalemate as both fleets move toward Infinite Guideline.
events.quote: We are in an unstable double stalemate.

events.summary: Mantis asks whether Vondam would destroy the station to stop the artifact, and he says yes.
events.quote: Would you destroy this station and the eternity column, trapping yourself in Sothera, in order to prevent the artifact from escaping?

events.summary: Vondam predicts his former student will come to Infinite Guideline to steal an eternity drive.
events.quote: Infinite Guideline has an eternity column, and it is the only place in the system with eternity drive ferries that can lift her ship into warp.

events.summary: A Free Company search radar sweeps toward the drifting Seriema.
events.quote: Search radar howls across the dark.

events.summary: The Free Company radar is abruptly jammed by an unseen attacker.
events.quote: The Free Company radar abruptly shuts off.

events.summary: Fleets from both sides accelerate toward Infinite Guideline.
events.quote: Dozens of fusion-drive flames are accelerating toward Infinite Guideline and the eternity column.

events.summary: Tannuk admits he is lying to Sami to protect them, but it is too late.
events.quote: "It's that kind of lie," Tannuk says.

events.summary: Sami reveals their real plan is to ask Pinnacle, the Free Company and the Monoists for help.
events.quote: Sami's plan is to ask for help.

events.summary: Sami promises to return for Mirri.
events.quote: I won't be leaving Mirri behind. I'll come back for her.

events.summary: Alpharael says he wants to use the stone so his sister never took the Plummet.
events.quote: I want to use it so that my sister never took the Plummet.

events.summary: An Illvoi ship arrives beside the Seriema.
events.quote: A ship appears beside them.

events.summary: The Illvoi extend a superfluid helium bubble around the Seriema.
events.quote: they snug their ship up close and extend their helium bubble around Sami's ship.

events.summary: Illvoi mechans cool the Seriema and begin repairing its fusion drive.
events.quote: Then the mechans swarm over the Seriema 's stern to repair the fusion drive.

events.summary: Mm'menon introduces themself and asks to come aboard.
events.quote: I am Mm'menon. May I come aboard your home?

events.summary: Mm'menon explains they were expelled from the Uthros Combine and deduced a causality manipulator.
events.quote: I was thrown out of the Uthros Combine

events.summary: Mm'menon says the Endstone is one of many anomalies in Sothera.
events.quote: "The Endstone is one of many anomalies," Mm'menon says.

events.summary: Tezzeret plans to sell the Endstone to its maker, using Mm'menon's ship to boost the Seriema to Infinite Guideline.
events.quote: We will take the Endstone there, and I will sell it to its maker in exchange for a glimpse of their power.

events.summary: Tezzeret says he will not be changed by any hand but his own.
events.quote: I will not be changed by any hand except my own.

events.summary: Tezzeret assigns Mm'menon to provide stealthy speed.
events.quote: Your role, Mm'menon, is to provide us with stealthy speed.

events.summary: Tezzeret admits he is saving his own ship in case he must abandon the others.
events.quote: You're saving it in case you need to abandon the rest of us to die.

events.summary: Sami threatens to blow up the ship rather than let Tezzeret harm Haliya, invoking mallowmass.
events.quote: "I will detonate this ship if I have to," Sami says.

events.summary: Tezzeret tells Sami nothing is sacred, only useful, and challenges Sami to prove guest right is useful.
events.quote: Nothing's sacred. Only useful.

events.summary: Sami lays out a plan for Haliya and Alpharael to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline's docking arms.
events.quote: Haliya and Alpharael will use armor to leap from the Seriema to one of the harbormaster modules at the end of Infinite Guideline's docking arms.

events.summary: Haliya agrees to send the message, saying she will carry out her duty to report to Vondam and beg pardon for Alpharael.
events.quote: All I can do is carry out my next duty. To return to Vondam, make my report, and beg pardon for Alpharael.

events.summary: Haliya says she will not become someone who kills innocents in their homes.
events.quote: I don't want to be someone who kills innocents in their homes.

events.summary: Alpharael says he will go where the stone goes because it has kept him alive.
events.quote: I want to live. The stone's kept me alive.

events.summary: Tannuk says he goes only because he has no choice and fears the rock.
events.quote: "I'm going 'cause I have no choice," he says.

events.summary: A narrator describes alternate branches for where the crystal might point, rejects each, and says to go back and choose better.
events.quote: Go back and make a better choice.

relations.note: Vondam describes his squire as a student, a Solar Knight in training.
Sami calls Tezzeret 'my lord' while testing the phrase for irony.
relations.quote: "Yes, my lord," Sami says, testing out the phrase for irony.

relations.note: Mantis chose to strive for Pinnacle rather than the Eumidian brood.
relations.quote: chose to spend her life striving instead for Pinnacle and the greater growth of all life in the universe.
As a Eumidian, Mantis knows how dearly a home can matter, even when it's trying to kill you.

relations.note: The Palatinate stands behind the Free Company.
relations.quote: Behind the Free Company stands the titanic might of the Celestial Palatinate
I want to use it so that my sister never took the Plummet.
